messages:
Kai (AE): Hi team — kicking off the ProspectX migration POC. They want a drop-in replacement for their current /v1/complete endpoint. Main asks: deterministic parity for 3 regulatory prompts, per-request billing trace, SSO + BYOK. SE + Sec + Pricing pls advise.

Rina (SE): Short notes: they call /v1/complete sync, avg 80 tokens, ~320k tokens/day. Primary risk is tokenization differences causing billing deltas and nondeterministic outputs for templates. Plan: provide a tiny adapter + run parity harness (golden exact-match, token delta, semantic sim).

Mark (Prospect Eng): We can share the 3 golden templates and a 1k sample set. Need sandbox and an IP allowlist. Determinism is deal-blocker for compliance.

Rina (SE): Adapter example (one-liner):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"{{prompt}}","model":"redwood-1"}'
```
We can also provide a gRPC->REST shim if needed.

Eli (Security): BYOK/KMS supported on Dedicated and Private; hosted uses envelope encryption by default (no hosted BYOK). SSO/SCIM available for enterprise console. Default log retention masked 90d, extendable via contract. Will send prefilled vendor questionnaire.

Jules (Pricing): Ballpark hosted: $0.0065 / 1k gen tokens. Dedicated reserve estimate for their volume: ~$29k/month (6mo). Can refine once we get invoices. Note PS for KMS automation.

staging-bot: sandbox ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/prospectx (id: 8342), staging key: PX_STG_8342. egress IPs: 34.98.12.5, 34.98.12.6.

Mark (Prospect Eng): Got it, sending golden templates + invoices via secure link. We'll run a 200-prompt smoke tonight if you drop the harness.

Rina (SE): We'll drop the parity harness repo and runbook in the next message. Plan: 200-prompt smoke tonight, full 1.2k run during POC week. Acceptance criteria: golden templates exact match 100%, semantic sim >=0.95, token delta <=2%, p95 latency <300ms on Dedicated.

Kai (AE): Scheduling 30m kickoff with ProspectX, SE, Sec, Pricing tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: parity scope, security Qs, pricing options. Marking CRM: prospectx-swap-poc.

Rina (SE): Dropping adapter + harness now. TL;DR: clone repo, set REDWOOD_KEY, run ./smoke.sh --sample 200. :thumbsup:
